name: Garrett Welkin
original_name: ギャレット・ウェルキン
source:
[i]"When heroes break, the whole world will be tainted with despair."[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Commander of the Royal Order of Hemeria
[b]Interest:[/b] Stars
[b]Weapon:[/b] Spear

The hero of Hemeria, promoted to Commander of the Royal Order at a young age.

The reason behind his ascension to Commander at such a young age is due to the large scale vampire assault he faced in his youth. Many of his fellow trainees lost their lives, but he was the sole survivor, saving the lives of many citizens, and hailed as a hero. He is the public's brightest hope against their fear of vampires.

Although he has a serious and stubborn side, and claims to hate vampire hunters, he appears before the heroine as the commander of the hunt party.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=garrett]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
